title: Sources
subtitle: Connect the places VU Studio reads its data from: this PC, other devices on your network, home automation and online services. Every source adds sensors that you can show on a dial.

yours.title: Your sources
yours.emptyBody: Pick one from the list below. Each source adds sensors that you can then show on your dials.

add.title: Add a source
add.subtitle: Choose what you want to connect.
add.errorTitle: Could not load the source types
add.errorBody: VU Studio did not answer. Check that the service is running.
add.noMatch: No source type matches your search.
add.noTypes: This version of VU Studio has no source types.

thisPc.title: This PC
thisPc.description: Sensors of this computer: CPU, GPU, memory, disks and network.

software.title: Software
software.description: Audio, media, games, processes and the user session.

network.title: Network
network.description: Other computers and devices on your local network.

homeAutomation.title: Home automation
homeAutomation.description: Home Assistant, MQTT and smart-home devices.

utility.title: Utilities
utility.description: Clock, timers, scripts, the push API and demo data.

badges.desktopHint: This source runs in the VU Studio desktop app (in your user session), not in the background service.
badges.localOnlyHint: Its settings can only be changed from the PC that runs VU Studio.

card.lockedHint: You are using VU Studio from another device. This source can only be changed from the PC that runs it.
card.lockedAddHint: This type of source can only be added from the PC that runs VU Studio.

editor.readOnly: You are using VU Studio from another device. The settings of this source can only be changed from the PC that runs it.
editor.nameHelp: Optional. Helps you recognise it in lists, for example “Router” or “Studio”.
editor.idHelp: Starts every sensor id of this source, for example “ping-2/latency”. It cannot be changed after the source is created.
editor.idLockedEdit: The identifier cannot be changed: dials and profiles refer to the sensors by it.
editor.idLockedSingleton: This type of source can only exist once, so its identifier is fixed.

idError.pattern: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit (up to 63 characters).
idError.duplicate: A source with this identifier already exists.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The source “{{id}}” is removed from the configuration, and its sensors disappear from VU Studio once you save.
delete.usagePages_one: {{count}} dial page uses sensors of this source.
delete.usagePages_other: {{count}} dial pages use sensors of this source.
delete.usageConditions_one: {{count}} profile condition watches one of its sensors.
delete.usageHint: They will have no data until you choose another sensor.
delete.autoCreated: VU Studio creates this source again every time it starts. To keep it off for good, turn it off instead of deleting it.
